# Sevlumen PostgreSQL v1.1.1

This backward-compatible patch restores standard `database/sql` pointer-parameter behavior required by nullable ORM fields.

## Fixed

- dereference non-nil pointers to supported positional parameter values;
- encode nil pointers as PostgreSQL `NULL`;
- honor `driver.Valuer` implementations such as `sql.NullString`;
- preserve wrapped Valuer conversion errors;
- validate pointer and Valuer parameters against PostgreSQL 14 through 18.

## Compatibility

- no public API changes;
- Go 1.23 and current stable Go;
- Linux, macOS and Windows;
- PostgreSQL 14, 15, 16, 17 and 18;
- no runtime dependencies, CGo, `pgx` or `libpq`.

The release assets contain a deterministic source archive, exact source commit and SHA-256 checksums.
